about: The reference Find All (ADR-0470 §2): every cell a Find step would stop on, in the order a forward walk from the start meets them, a page at a time with the exact count. Rows are written as the texts their cells display, as in find.json.

cases.name: ADR-0470 §2: every match, by rows and across a row in column order, with the exact count
ADR-0470 §2: a page is the range asked, and the count is the whole list's
ADR-0470 §2: the last page holds what is left
ADR-0470 §2: a page past the end holds nothing, and still says the count
ADR-0470 §2 / ADR-0055: the displayed text is matched and listed, never the raw value
ADR-0470 §2 / ADR-0023: case is ignored as OrdinalIgnoreCase ignores it, unless Match case
ADR-0470 §2 / ADR-0055: Whole cell lists only the cells equal to the text
ADR-0470 §1: within a selected scope only its cells are listed, a cell two ranges cover once
ADR-0470 §1: the columns are the request's, in its order
ADR-0470 §2 / ADR-0055: a column the source does not know has no text to search, and is skipped
ADR-0470 §2 / ADR-0055: an empty text lists nothing
ADR-0470 §2: nothing matching lists nothing, counted as 0
ADR-0470 §2: a page starting before the first entry is refused
ADR-0470 §2: a page of no entries is refused
